steps.en: Scaffold a project with the wizard, adding any UI integration you need
steps.zh: 用向导生成项目，顺便加上需要的 UI 集成

steps.en: Write pages as .astro components under src/pages
steps.zh: 在 src/pages 下用 .astro 组件写页面

steps.en: Add Markdown and MDX as content when you need it
steps.zh: 需要时把 Markdown 与 MDX 作为内容加进来

steps.en: Builds every component to HTML and CSS, stripping client-side JavaScript by default
steps.zh: 把每个组件构建成 HTML 与 CSS，默认剥离客户端 JavaScript

steps.en: Mark only the components that must be interactive
steps.zh: 只标注那些必须可交互的组件

steps.en: Bundles JavaScript for those islands alone and writes the static site
steps.zh: 只为这些 island 打包 JavaScript，并写出静态站点

value.en: A content site that ships HTML by default and JavaScript only where you opted in — from any UI framework
value.zh: 内容站默认只发 HTML，只有你主动开启的地方才带 JavaScript——而且 UI 框架任选

sources: README.md Install ('npm create astro@latest' recommended, 'npm install astro' manual; 'Astro is a website build tool for the modern web')

https://docs.astro.build/en/install-and-setup/ (prerequisites Node v22.12.0+, odd-numbered versions unsupported; astro must be installed locally, not globally; scripts dev/build/preview as 'astro dev' / 'astro build' / 'astro preview'; src/pages/index.astro; astro.config.mjs with defineConfig; integrations imported there; 'npm create astro@latest -- --add react --add partytown')

https://docs.astro.build/en/concepts/islands/ (components render to HTML with no client-side runtime by default; 'stripping out all client-side JavaScript automatically'; client:* directives client:load, client:idle, client:visible; server:defer for server islands; multiple UI frameworks supported)
packages/ listing (astro, create-astro, markdown, integrations/* including @astrojs/mdx, adapters for node/vercel/netlify/cloudflare, telemetry, language-tools)
README.md integrations table (@astrojs/react, preact, solid-js, svelte, vue, node, vercel, cloudflare, sitemap, mdx)
